comment:
* Signer with message recovery.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public boolean hasFullMessage()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the signer has recovered the full message as
     * part of signature verification.
     * 
     * @return true if full message recovered.

methods.name: public byte[] getRecoveredMessage()
methods.comment:
* Returns a reference to what message was recovered (if any).
     * 
     * @return full/partial message, null if nothing.

methods.name: public void updateWithRecoveredMessage(byte[] signature) throws InvalidCipherTextException
methods.comment:
* Perform an update with the recovered message before adding any other data. This must
     * be the first update method called, and calling it will result in the signer assuming
     * that further calls to update will include message content past what is recoverable.
     *
     * @param signature the signature that we are in the process of verifying.
     * @throws IllegalStateException

methodNames: public void updateWithRecoveredMessage(byte[] signature) throws InvalidCipherTextException
